Maria G: hey team — heads up, I just merged #4827 (error-ref edits) and CI flagged a couple of broken links and one bad SDK snippet for fallback behavior. can someone help triage? :wave:
Raj P: on it. which links/snippet specifically?
Maria G: the link to our runtime fallback policy doc 404s (link points to /docs/fallbacks/runtime). also the python snippet under 'client retries + fallback' uses old arg names:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY, timeout_ms=3000)  # old param name
resp = client.generate(prompt)
```
should be `timeout` and `create` -> `generate` is fine but the param rename matters for examples.
Kevin L: I can patch the link path. quick grep shows other pages linking to /docs/fallbacks/runtime too. i'll push a redirect or update references.
Raj P: i'll open a small PR to fix the python snippet and add a test snippet run in the docs CI. want to keep examples runnable.
Anya (docs-bot): Reminder: docs CI currently runs on PRs with /docs change label. Add `docs:examples` tag to trigger snippet lint.
Maria G: thanks. Kevin, can you also check the JS example under the same section? i remember there was a note about `retryPolicy` vs `fallbackPolicy`.
Kevin L: yep, JS snippet has `retryPolicy: 'auto'` which is deprecated. should be `retry: { mode: 'adaptive' }`. i'll update.
Raj P: created PR #4832 with python snippet fix + a tiny unit test that imports the example and asserts param names are valid. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4832
Maria G: nice. i've queued #4828 to update internal redirects for /docs/fallbacks/runtime -> /docs/serving/fallbacks.
Raj P: QA question: do we want to mention 429s explicitly in the fallback doc? current text talks about 'rate-limited' but not the 429 HTTP code, which causes confusion for support cases.
Maria G: good call. add a short appendix: example 429 response and recommended client behavior (backoff + switch to a cheaper model) — but keep it brief.
Kevin L: i can add a single-line code example showing how to detect 429 and swap model: 
```js
if (resp.status === 429) {
  client.options.model = 'redwood-small-quant'; // cheaper/compatible fallback
  // retry with exponential backoff
}
```
Raj P: small nit — we should prefer to show `retry-after` header handling: `const wait = parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || '1', 10)`. i'll add that to the python snippet too.
Maria G: sounds good. timeline? we've got a support ticket referencing the broken link and snippet. i'd like fixes live today if possible. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kevin L: i'll cut a patch for links in ~20m and add a short redirect rule in the nginx config (docs infra).
Raj P: my PR is ready for review. pinging @Kevin L for a quick merge after link patch lands.
deploy-bot: deploy started for docs-site change set 2026-03-25T15:42:12Z
Anya (docs-bot): CI — snippet lint passed on #4832, please include `CHANGELOG.md` entry for user-visible change.
Maria G: added changelog blurb. thanks everyone. after deployment, i'll message support with the update and close the ticket. :white_check_mark:
